messages:
anya (partnerships): Quick sync — retail PoC with Snowflake -> Databricks -> Qdrant. Goal: demo fast vector search over product catalogs + personalized recs. Need to align ingestion, schema mapping, and announcement timing. Suggested PoC window: Jun 10–24.
marcus (eng-ml): +1. Main risks: CDC latency and embedding cost. I'll prototype Snowflake Streams -> Snowpipe -> Databricks Autoloader -> batch embedding job.
leo (sdks): For embeddings we'll expose a small SDK wrapper so SI partners can call the hosted embedding service or run locally. POC API will be the same for both.
sophia (product): Can we target a joint announcement with partner marketing in late July? That gives time for a short bake, doc + marketplace listing draft. @rebecca can you own the GTM checklist? :sparkles: 
rebecca (sales): I can. Need one pager, logos, required security checklist (SOC2/KMS). Also confirm if partner wants co-marketing assets.
marcus (eng-ml): Prototype CDC mapping idea (very rough):
```
-- Snowflake stream -> Autoloader in Databricks (pseudo)
CREATE STREAM products_stream ON TABLE products;
-- Databricks autoloader watches stage from Snowpipe
df = spark.readStream.format("cloudFiles")
  .option("cloudFiles.format", "json")
  .load("/mnt/snowpipe/products/")
```
Then run nightly batch to encode text->embedding and upsert to Qdrant. We can also try continuous micro-batching for lower latency.
anya (partnerships): Questions: 1) Which vector DB for PoC — Qdrant (managed) or Milvus? 2) Do we need a dedicated Redwood Dedicated pool for embedding throughput?
marcus (eng-ml): Let's start with Qdrant managed for speed. If embedding cost/throughput is high we can spin up Dedicated capacity for inference to hit SLOs.
sophia (product): Action items: 1) README + data schema (owner: marcus), 2) SDK wrapper (owner: leo), 3) GTM one-pager + PR plan (owner: rebecca), 4) Security checklist + legal intake (owner: anya). Can we have initial drafts by EOW? :eyes: 
qdrant-bot: Build succeeded for qdrant-adapter image ghcr.io/redwood/qdrant-adapter:1.2.0 (workflow #412)
leo (sdks): I'll drop a simple example repo under partners/retail-poc and add a quickstart with both hosted embedding and local runner.
rebecca (sales): I'll start the partner intro email draft — need partner contact, logo, and co-marketing ask.
anya (partnerships): Great. Follow-ups: schedule a 30-min technical sync with partner + SIs next Tue 9am PT. I'll send invite after I confirm availability. If anyone can't make that slot, ping me and we'll find another.
marcus (eng-ml): One more: we should add an eval harness measuring recall and embedding cost per 10k rows. I'll sketch that and share metrics template.
sophia (product): Perfect. Thanks all — will track in the PoC project board.
anya (partnerships): Thanks — closing thread for now, will post calendar + checklist link.
